name: deepseek-v4-1-flash-h100-agentx-4node
objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs

sweeps.name: topology
sweeps.narrative: Wide TP8 instances should win at the SLO, since narrow tp pays more per-step latency than the extra replicas buy back.

sweeps.name: ep-off
sweeps.narrative: Replicating all 128 experts should cost KV room and throughput against the EP twins in topology.

sweeps.name: drafting-depth
sweeps.narrative: Deeper dspark drafts should add tok/s, but the 20ms ITL bound should cap K lower on narrow tp than on TP8.

sweeps.name: batch-caps
sweeps.narrative: max_num_seqs should bind on TP8 ranks and not on TP2, while a small token cap trades throughput for tail ITL on both.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: Routed all-to-all backends should only pay once EP spans nodes, and hurt on narrow tp where buffers crowd KV.

sweeps.name: kv-and-engram
sweeps.narrative: Moving Engram tables into HBM should only pay when gmu leaves KV room for them, and cost more on narrow tp.
